name: a standing sheet of water
description: Where the door was there is a pane of water held upright in the frame, unsupported, its surface trembling slightly. The room on the far side of it is visible and about a second behind.
looks: The surface shivers in rings when anybody in the room speaks, including you.
Your reflection in it is doing what you are doing, with a delay you can just about measure.
A drip is forming at the bottom edge. It has been forming for a while and it is not going to fall.
says: You can come through. You will be wet on the other side, briefly.
Everything that has gone through me is still in me somewhere.
Speak up. It makes a nice pattern.
emotes: Rings run out across {it} from a point about head height.
{it} bulges towards the room and settles flat again.
The room reflected in {it} does something the room does not do.
asks: Are you going through, or are you looking at yourself?
Did somebody come through just before you?
Can you swim? It is not important. I am asking.
